ABOUT THE LAB

Curiosity, rendered.

Spatial is an evolving collection of artistic experiments made for the browser. Each work starts with a question: what could this medium do that another medium couldn’t?

Silk / wind makes your movement into an invisible force. Impossible water remembers each touch as a ripple. Afterimage weaves a temporary sculpture from the path of your hand. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

Drag to orbit, use arrow keys to rotate, and + or − to zoom. Save a frame to keep a moment, or enter immersive view to give the artwork the whole screen.
